_hinweis: Rezeptsammlungen (Hubs). tools/blocks.py baut daraus collections/<slug>.html. Ein Rezept gehoert dazu, wenn 'match' (regulaerer Ausdruck, ohne Gross/Klein) auf seinen Namen oder einen seiner Tags in recipes.html passt. Neue Rezepte landen so automatisch in der passenden Sammlung.

sorbet-and-ice-cream.label: Sorbet & ice cream
sorbet-and-ice-cream.title: No-Churn Sorbet & Ice Cream Recipes, Ready in 5 Minutes
sorbet-and-ice-cream.description: Fruit sorbets and nice cream made in the blender: frozen fruit, a few more ingredients, no ice cream maker and no churning. Most take four ingredients.
sorbet-and-ice-cream.intro: Every sorbet and ice cream here works the same way: frozen fruit goes into the blender with a few other ingredients and comes out creamy – no ice cream maker, no churning. Most need four ingredients and about five minutes.
